stem.text: An unknown mass and a $1.00\,\text{kg}$ mass are fixed at opposite ends of a bar. The bar has negligible mass and a length of $30.0\,\text{cm}$.
The bar balances when supported by a pivot placed $20.0\,\text{cm}$ from the unknown mass, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal bar with an unknown mass at its left end and a 1.00 kg mass at its right end, supported by a pivot; dimensions 30.0 cm (end to end) and 20.0 cm (unknown mass to pivot) are marked.
